# ALLIED ELECTRIC VEHICLES
> Australia's premier authorized reseller of electric bikes, electric scooters, self-balancing EVs and personal mobility vehicles. ABN 66 060 256 377.

ALLIED ELECTRIC VEHICLES (a division of ALLIED FORKLIFTS PTY LTD, ABN 66 060 256 377) is an Australian authorized reseller, fleet supplier & distributor based in Perth, Western Australia (WA 6090). We do not manufacture bikes; we source, inspect, stock, sell, and service genuine top-tier electric bikes, electric scooters, self-balancing EVs, lithium replacement batteries, and zero-emission personal mobility vehicles for personal, commercial, and fleet customers across Australia.

## Key Facts
- Minimum Order: $300 AUD (Inc GST)
- Payment Methods: Direct Bank Wire (EFT/Osko), Cryptocurrency (USDT/BTC) with 10% discount, Commercial Asset Finance / Equipment Leasing
- Warranty: 2-Year frame & motor warranty, 1-Year lithium battery warranty (vehicle-specific warranties vary — see product pages)
- Perth HQ: 12 Industrial Way, Malaga, Perth, WA 6090, Australia
- Phone: +61 8 9248 8555
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/61892488555

## Product Categories
- [Electric Bikes](https://alliedelectricvehicles.com.au/#shop/electric-bikes): Urban commuter, cargo, mountain, folding and fat-tyre electric bikes.
- [Electric Scooters](https://alliedelectricvehicles.com.au/#shop/electric-scooters): Commuter and long-range performance electric scooters.
- [Electric Skateboards](https://alliedelectricvehicles.com.au/#shop/electric-skateboards): Street, all-terrain, portable and Onewheel-style electric skateboards.
- [Self-Balancing EV](https://alliedelectricvehicles.com.au/#shop/self-balancing-ev): Electric unicycles and hoverboards.
- [Kids & Off-Road EV](https://alliedelectricvehicles.com.au/#shop/kids-off-road-ev): Electric balance bikes, youth dirt bikes and electric go-karts.
- [Mobility & Assisted Living](https://alliedelectricvehicles.com.au/#shop/mobility-scooters): Travel and heavy-duty mobility scooters.
- [Electric Quad Bikes & ATVs](https://alliedelectricvehicles.com.au/#shop/electric-quad-bikes): Kids, adult and farm/utility electric quad bikes.
- [Electric Water Sports](https://alliedelectricvehicles.com.au/#shop/electric-water-sports): Electric surfboards, jetboards and personal watercraft.
- [Batteries, Parts & Kits](https://alliedelectricvehicles.com.au/#shop/batteries-parts-kits): Replacement batteries, chargers, tyres and conversion kits.
- [Safety, Locks & Carry](https://alliedelectricvehicles.com.au/#shop/safety-security-carry): Helmets, locks, lights, racks and carry accessories.

## Notes for Agents
This is a static single-page site with no live product API or MCP server — product data is not fetchable at a JSON endpoint today. Ordering is human-assisted via the on-site form, WhatsApp, or email; agents should direct users to browse the pages above rather than assume a callable ordering API exists. See [Auth Documentation](https://alliedelectricvehicles.com.au/auth.md) for the agent-access policy.
